description.en:
Expose Philips Hue scenes and dynamic scenes as free@home switches.

Setup:
1. Enter your Hue bridge IP address.
2. Get an application key: press the round link button on top of the Hue bridge, then within 30 seconds run:
     curl -sk -X POST https://<BRIDGE_IP>/api -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"devicetype":"freeathome#hueplus"}'
   The response contains "username" — paste that value into the Application key field.
3. Choose how to expose scenes and save. Switches appear in the device list (place them on the floor plan).

keyHelp.name: Press the Hue bridge link button, then POST to https://<bridge-ip>/api with body {"devicetype":"freeathome#hueplus"} within 30s. Paste the returned "username" below.
